# mcloud metrics

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Show an app's requests, errors, latency, queues and jobs.

Show an app's numbers from the platform's Prometheus, the ones the
"Run platform" Grafana dashboard has: per HTTP function (Knative service)
its requests over the window, how many were 5xx, the 95th percentile
latency and its pods now; per queue function the jobs waiting, as KEDA
last read them; and the app's running and failed Jobs.

The platform answers only the app's owners and admins, with your mcloud
login.

```
mcloud metrics [APP] [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud metrics                  # the last hour
mcloud metrics shop --window 7d
mcloud metrics --json | jq '.services[] | select(.errorRatio > 0.01)'
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | print JSON instead of a table (fields: docs/mcloud.md, JSON output) |
| `--window` string | `1h` | how far back the numbers go: 5m to 15d (e.g. 15m, 24h, 7d) |
